content: Jesús yoini Dios fu tsainti pushu paoinshquiran ishon
Ascatan Jesús Dios fu tsainti pushu murannoashu caiton non afu rafuafoan yoini, —Ifon, oinpon. Nocon Dios fu tsainti pushu fasi sharashtacoinran, —non huaiton.

Noco cumani, —Ai. Nan icon. Natian Dios fu tsainti pushu toquiri putsamuashu cunuacua sharashtacoin. Ascafiashu nan man oiain chipo paoincanocai afanan rato toquirishta tushushquima, putsamushquima. Nantifi paoinquin cuyocoinshquiran, —ishon Jesús noco yoini.
Nan cuyoaitian ahuarafo iishquiai cuscan

Ascatan machi Olivo ano mapufaintan Jesús tsaoni tsoa futsa anomano non afu rafuafoan yocaqui isca huani, —¿Nan min yoiai cuscan ahuutian ishquimun? ¿Ahuuscashomun non tapitiroquin nantifi cuyoaitian min afanan oshquiai? Noco yoihuu, —non huaiton.
Jesús noco cumani, —Oinfain mato paranonfoma.
Yora ichapafoan “Un Cristoran,” ishon mato parapaishcani. Ascashon yora ichapafori parashcani.
Ascaino mani futsafo ya futsafo rutunainfoan man nicashquin. Ascara nicacani ratuyamacahuun. Un mato yoimisi cuscan nanscacoin aiquin. Ascafia nantifi cuyoaitian icataima.
Mai futsa ariafo fu futsafo ya rutunainfoanno mani futsafori mani futsafo ya rutunanshquicani. Ascaino mai futsafoanri yora tushuomafo icaifoanno. Mai futsafo ari fasi mai nayanaiyaishquin.
Nanscaifin omitsiscai taushcaniquin. Ascafia chipo fasi finacai omitsiscashcani.
Ascano mato achicashon omitsisca huaquin mato rutushcani. Uhuunshon manifotiton mato noicasmashcani.
Ascaino nantianri atirifi yorafoan ua cachiquiri huashquicani afanancai tsoan ua icoinra huashquicanima. Nanfo afiranan achinantananshcani noincasmatanancani.
Ascaino nan fuparamitsamisifoan yoiqui isca huashcani, “Unfin Diospan tsain yoimisiquin,” ishon mato yoishcani. Afocai Diosin tsain yoimisiyamafiashon yora ichapafo ato icoinra huamashcani.
Ascaifoanno fasi yora chaca huaquin finacoinshcani. Ascashocai afanan atirifi yorafoan Diosi noishcanima.
Ascafia nan omitsisca huafiaifoan tsoan ua cachiquiri huatama tunufain uhuun tsain tanasharacun un cushusharatiro Uhuun Upa Diosin icano afu ipasharanon.
Ascano nan tsain shara Diosin nantifi yorafo iquinai cuscan manifoti uhuun tsain yoimisifoan yoiaitian un afanan oshquin.
Ascacun Daniel nan Diosin tsain yoimisiton inon pacoai cuscan cunuqui isca huani,

content.text: “Dios fu tsainti pushu muran ahuara fasi chacacoinfo futsafoan huanonpacoinran,”

content: ishon cununi. Ascacun nan tapicahuun. Daniel cununi cuscacoin aiton oin nan Judea ano icafoan machi ari ichoriscatacahuun.
Ascan tsoa pushu fomancayan niashucai afanan ahuun pushu muran iquitiroma ahuara fiishquin. Ascatama ichoriscatahuun.
Nanscarifiai tsoacai mau ano yonofiai afanan ahuun pushu ano nasotiroma ahuun sahuuti fiishquin.
Ascacun ohua ainfo nan facu nanuafo yafi aton facu yomumishti chocho acaifo omitsiscaashcani.
Ascacun Upa Dios cuficahuun nan omitsiscaitian oipacutian yafi tunutitianri ascanonma. Ascan nantian ascayamaino man ichoima.

Nan omitsiscaitiancai tsoan ascara oinyomisima cuscara fasi yorafo omitsiscai finacoinshcani. Diosin yora onihuaquin tau huani chaincai tsoa omitsiscai ascayomisima. Ascashucai tsoari afanan omitsiscai ascanacama.
Ascashu nan omitsiscaifotian nantifi yorafo cuyocuashquin. Diosin ahuun yorafo nan catoanfo atohuun ramapaiqui omitsiscaifotian ato shatumariscashquin.

Ascacun ua nicasharacahuun. Omitsiscaifotiancai icataima iquisi un mato yoiyoi. Nan omitsiscaifotianri nan fuparamitsamisifo fucani. Fucashon yoiqui isca huacani, “Un Cristoran,” ishon yoi yamarai “Un Diospan tsain yoimisiran,” ishon nanfoan yoishcani. Ascashon nanfoanri Satanashuunshon tsoan atiroma cuscara mato ismaquin mato parapaishcani. Ascan Diosin nan catoanfo ato cushuyamaino nanfoanri nan fuparamitsamisifo icoinra huaacuana. Ascaino nantian mato yoishcani, “¡Oincapon! Nanfin nocon Cristoqui,” ishon yoi iyamarai, “Nanno chaimashta Cristo nocoqui oaran,” ishon yoiaifoan ato icoinra huayamacahuun.

Ascashon nanfoanri yoicani, “Cristo tsoan istaipama ano nocoaran,” ishon mato yoiaifoanno ari foyamacahuun. Nanscarifi aquin mato yoishcani, “Criston nan pushu cunu muran iquiaran,” ishon mato yoiaifoan ato icoinra huayamacahuun.
Uficoin un oaiton man ua shafacafi oinshquin. Canan facaicaiton shafacafi nantio non oinriscatatiro. Nanscarifiai unfin Diospan Facuquin un afanan oaiton nantifi yorafoan ua shafacafi oinshcani.
Ahuara naa nanno cotocotofo nocoriscatiro. Nanscarifiai un nocoaitian ua tanamisifo uqui furiscashcani.
Diospan facu nasoaitian

Ascashu nan omitsiscaifo cuscan anaitiano fari afanan chashayamafain oshuricai afanan chashashquima faquishicoin iishquin. Ascaino fishifori nai ariashu pacui futsushquin. Nantifi nai murannoafori nayanaiyaishquin.

Ascashon ahuarafo nai arishon un ismai cuscacoin aiton tapitirofo un afanan mai ano nasoai cuscan nantifi yorafoan tapinonfo. Un Diospan facushon un nantifi iquinai cuscan. Un nai murannoashu coin camaqui fotoaiton oincani manifoti nan icoinra huamafo fasi ratucani uaishcani. Uhuun curushhuunoashu un fotoaiton oincani.
Ascaino nantianri uhuun oinmatifo ufu nai muran icafo un nichishquin aton manuti fasi curushcai chaan chaan acaino uhuun yorafo manifoti anoafo yafi nai murannoafori uqui fushcani.
Ascacun un mato fana huiguerahuunoa ahuara futsa yoinon. Ua nicasharacahuun. Huiguera pui risquisi futsuaiton man tapitiro faritian itiro cuscan.
Nanscarifiai nan un mato yoiai cuscacoin aiton tapicahuun mun oti chaima nanscacoin aiquin.
Ascacun un mato icon yoi. Ahuarafo un mato yoiai cuscacoin aiton nataishoma oinyocani.
Ascaino nai yafi mai cuyoshquin. Uhuun tsain cayacafi iconcoin fiananancai apanacama. Un mato yoiai cuscacoin aashquin.

Ascafia ahuutiaran un nai ariashu afanan fotoainocai tsoan tapiama. Diosin oinmati afu icafoanricai tapiafoma. Urifi uhuun Upa Diosin facufiashocai un tapiama. Nan uhuun Upa Diosin fustitofin tapiaquin.
Noco shuni Noé niyoano inifo cuscacoinrifiai afanan un oaitian nanscarifi ashcani.
Ascano nantian tsoan Dios shinantama pii sharafain ayafain fianansharacainaifoanno. Fai tahuan noconi. Nanscasi ariaifoanno Noé ahuun shashohuan muran iquini.
Ascashu iquifiaitocai tsoan tapinima fai tahuan nocoai. Ascashu nantifi yorafo asai futsunifo. Nanscacoinrifi aashcani un afanan oaitian. Ua shinantama afi apaiyaifo cuscasi huariaifoanno.
Ascaino nantianri nocofunu rafu mau ano yonocani futsa uari cai yamariscatanaino. Futsa nitushquin omitsiscapanacafo muran caashquin.
Nanscarifiaiyainfon rafu nanincani. Futsa uari cai yamariscatanaino futsa nitushquin omitsiscapashquin.
Ascacun itisharacahuun. Un maton ifofiacucai marifi man tapiama ahuutiamain un afanan matoqui oshquicain. Un mato yoimisi cuscan nanscacoin acahuun.
Ua nicasharacahuun tapishcaquin. Pushu ifoan iquisi itisharashon yomutso yamu ahuuscaraino ahuun pushu muran iquiai tapishocai iquimatiroma.
Nanscarifiai marifi itisharacahuun. “Iscaino nocon Ifo oimaran,” ishon shinanyamacahuun. Ahuuscara atanaino un matoqui nocoriscaiquin.
Oinmati rafu futsa ifoan yonoai cuscacoin aino futsa nan yonoai cuscacoin aima

Man tapinon un mato yoi ahuu cuscaramain oinmati shara itiroquin. Niaifocoin mai futsa ari caquin niaifo patashari yoitiro isca huaquin, “Uhuun oinmati futsafo ato tushu shafatifi inanhuun. Nanticoin rafu ato pashcananshara huahuun. Ascashon ua ato cushusharashohuun,” huafaini catiro.
Ascatan niaifocoin afanan nocoshon oian ahuun niaifo patashari nan yoia cuscacoin aano fasi aqui unimacointiro. Ascashon naan shara huatiro.
Ascacun un mato icon yoi. Nan niaifoan ahuun oinmati yoi, “¡Aicho! Natian nantifi uhuunafo mian cushusharashotiroran,” ishon yoitiro.
Ascafia niaifo patashari chacapan ahuun nomuran shinanquin isca huatiro, “Uhuun ifo funa nasoimaran,” ishon shinanquin.
Oinmati futsafo nantifi sutuqui futsatiro. Ascashon shafatifi nan paunmisifo ya pauncain monocai.
Ascashon shinantiro isca huaquin, “Natiancai uhuun niaifo oimaran,” ifiaino samamashta nocoriscatiro.

Ascashon niaifoan nan niaifo patashari fasi onaintimai. Asca huatan ahuun oinmati futsafo yonoqui isca huai, “Nan omitsiscapanacafo muran fuparamitsamisifo ano nan chaca potacahuun,” ishon ato yoishquin. Ascan nannoashu uaiqui omitsiscapanaca.
